-- ============================================
-- MM2 Trade Bot v9 — Hardcoded pixel coords
-- Generated by Cobalt — https://gitlab.com/upio/cobalt
-- ============================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Trade = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Trade", 10)
local SendRequest = Trade:WaitForChild("SendRequest", 10)
local OfferItem   = Trade:WaitForChild("OfferItem", 10)
local AcceptTrade = Trade:WaitForChild("AcceptTrade", 10)

local TARGET_USERNAME = "aquxtic_jaz"
local ITEM_DATAID     = "Strawberries_G_2026"
local ITEM_TYPE       = "Weapons"

local VIM = pcall(function() return game:GetService("VirtualInputManager") end)
    and game:GetService("VirtualInputManager") or nil

-- coords copier GUI
local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screen.Name = "PosCopier"
screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
screen.DisplayOrder = 999
screen.Parent = PlayerGui

local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 40)
label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0, 10)
label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
label.Text = "Waiting for trade GUI..."
label.TextScaled = true
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.Parent = screen

local function safeCall(fn, label_)
    local ok, err = pcall(fn)
    print("[v9] " .. label_ .. (ok and " ✓" or " ✗ " .. tostring(err)))
end

local function getTarget()
    local t = 0
    local target
    repeat
        task.wait(0.5)
        t = t + 0.5
        target = Players:FindFirstChild(TARGET_USERNAME)
    until target or t >= 15
    return target
end

local function getAcceptButton()
    local gui = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("TradeGUI_Phone")
    if not gui then return nil end
    local ok, btn = pcall(function()
        return gui.Container.Trade.Actions.Accept.ActionButton
    end)
    return ok and btn or nil
end

local capturedX = nil
local capturedY = nil

local function smashAccept()
    safeCall(function()
        AcceptTrade:FireServer()
    end, "M1 remote")

    local btn = getAcceptButton()
    if btn then
        safeCall(function() btn.MouseButton1Click:Fire() end, "M2 Click")
        safeCall(function() btn.Activated:Fire() end, "M2 Activated")
        safeCall(function()
            btn.MouseButton1Down:Fire(0, 0)
            task.wait(0.05)
            btn.MouseButton1Up:Fire(0, 0)
        end, "M2 Down+Up")
    end

    -- use captured coords if we have them, else fallback to button center
    local x, y
    if capturedX and capturedY then
        x = capturedX
        y = capturedY
        print("[v9] Using captured coords " .. x .. "," .. y)
    elseif btn then
        local pos = btn.AbsolutePosition
        local size = btn.AbsoluteSize
        x = pos.X + size.X / 2
        y = pos.Y + size.Y / 2 + 5
        print("[v9] Using button center+5 " .. math.floor(x) .. "," .. math.floor(y))
    end

    if x and y and VIM then
        safeCall(function()
            VIM:SendMouseMoveEvent(x, y, game)
            task.wait(0.05)
            VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, true, game, 1)
            task.wait(0.05)
            VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, false, game, 1)
        end, "M3 VIM at " .. math.floor(x) .. "," .. math.floor(y))
    end
end

local function run()
    print("[v9] Starting — looking for " .. TARGET_USERNAME .. "...")

    local target = getTarget()
    if not target then
        warn("[v9] Target not found. Stopping.")
        return
    end
    print("[v9] Found target ✓")

    safeCall(function()
        SendRequest:InvokeServer(target)
    end, "SendRequest")

    local phoneGui = PlayerGui:WaitForChild("TradeGUI_Phone", 30)
    local guiOpened = false

    local conn = phoneGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if phoneGui.Enabled then
            guiOpened = true
            label.Text = "TAP ACCEPT TO CAPTURE"

            -- capture tap position while trade is open
            local tapConn
            tapConn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                    capturedX = math.floor(input.Position.X)
                    capturedY = math.floor(input.Position.Y)
                    local coords = "Captured: " .. capturedX .. "," .. capturedY
                    label.Text = coords
                    setclipboard(coords)
                    print("[v9] " .. coords)
                    tapConn:Disconnect()
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    local t = 0
    while not guiOpened and t < 30 do
        task.wait(0.5)
        t = t + 0.5
    end
    conn:Disconnect()

    if not guiOpened then
        warn("[v9] Trade never opened. Stopping.")
        return
    end

    print("[v9] Trade GUI open ✓")
    task.wait(0.5)

    safeCall(function()
        OfferItem:FireServer(ITEM_DATAID, ITEM_TYPE)
    end, "OfferItem")

    print("[v9] Waiting 6s for accept window...")
    task.wait(6)

    local tradeDone = false
    local closeConn
    closeConn = phoneGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if not phoneGui.Enabled then
            tradeDone = true
            if closeConn then closeConn:Disconnect() end
        end
    end)

    local attempts = 0
    while not tradeDone and attempts < 25 do
        attempts = attempts + 1
        print("[v9] Attempt " .. attempts)
        smashAccept()
        task.wait(0.4)
    end

    if tradeDone then
        print("[v9] Trade done ✓ — leaving...")
    else
        print("[v9] Max attempts — leaving anyway...")
    end

    task.wait(1.5)
    TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LocalPlayer)
end

task.spawn(run)
